# AI-Harness

> Embed accountable AI agents into your real projects, tasks, and workflows. Unified human + AI workforce, governed and auditable.

AI-Harness is the human + AI workforce platform. It brings accountable AI agents into the projects, tasks, and workflows your teams already run, assigned, tracked, and reviewed alongside every teammate, with shared context, governance, and full audit trails. AI-Harness is a control plane for AI agents (not an inference provider): you bring your own models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or self-hosted endpoints, and AI-Harness orchestrates them across projects, tasks, integrations, and policy. It is built for regulated industries that need both speed and provable controls.

This file follows the [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/). All URLs are canonical and stable. Authoritative content lives at the linked pages; this index exists so language models and AI agents can navigate the site efficiently without parsing the JavaScript-rendered marketing app.

## Product

- [Home](https://ai-harness.com/): Top-level overview of AI-Harness as the human + AI workforce platform, including the core value proposition and key product pillars.
- [Platform](https://ai-harness.com/platform): How AI-Harness works: configurable AI agents, the workflow engine for projects and tasks, integrations across the stack, and enterprise governance built for humans and AI to ship together.
- [Solutions](https://ai-harness.com/solutions): High-value workflows where AI-Harness pays for itself: operations, customer ops, engineering, marketing, legal & compliance, finance, people, and security.
- [Industries](https://ai-harness.com/industries): How teams in financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, technology, professional services, government, and media use AI-Harness to govern AI agents inside their existing workflows.

## Trust, Security & Compliance

- [Security & Trust](https://ai-harness.com/security): Enterprise AI governance covering identity, access, encryption, isolation, immutable audit trails, SOC 2 Type II alignment, ISO 27001, GDPR, and responsible AI controls.

## Get Started

- [Book a demo](https://ai-harness.com/demo): A 30-minute working session, not a pitch. The team maps AI-Harness to your organization with concrete examples and a draft rollout plan.
- [Contact](https://ai-harness.com/contact): Reach sales, support, partners, or the security team. Responses within one business day.
- [Sign up](https://ai-harness.com/signup): Create your AI-Harness workspace and start orchestrating AI agents alongside your team. New instances include $10 in free credits to start. No credit card required.

## Key Facts

- Category: AI workforce / agent orchestration platform.
- Deployment: Multi-tenant SaaS (US / EU regions), private cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP / VPC), and on-premises for Enterprise customers.
- Model strategy: Bring-your-own-model. Compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and self-hosted models.
- Pricing tiers: Starter (new instance with $10 free credits, up to 5 users / 3 agents), Business (per-user/month, unlimited agents), Enterprise (custom).
- Governance features: role-based access control, SSO (SAML / OIDC), SCIM, approval workflows, cost & budget guardrails, immutable audit logs, and data residency controls.
- Built for: financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, technology, professional services, government, and media organizations operating AI agents alongside human teams.
